name: Femto Mega

sources.title: Femto Mega Datasheet v1.1, Orbbec
sources.covers: technology (iToF), shutters, wavelength, depth and RGB modes (resolution, FoV, fps, range, format), depth error, IMU, data connections, power modes and consumption, dimensions, weight, installation, multi-camera sync

note: An iToF depth camera with an NVIDIA Jetson Nano for in-camera processing, USB 3.2 Gen 1 or Gigabit Ethernet (PoE+). Poses: the body origin is the ToF depth camera (the reference imager). The RGB camera's offset and orientation are not stated (calibration is read from the device): placed at the depth origin with the same orientation as an ASSUMPTION (pose_stated false). The ToF illuminator (850 nm) is not entered as a projector (field of illumination and position not stated). Depth modes as stated: WFOV 1024 x 1024 (5, 15 fps, 0.25-2.21 m) and 512 x 512 (5-30 fps, 0.25-2.88 m) at 120 x 120 deg; NFOV 640 x 576 (0.5-3.86 m) and 320 x 288 (0.5-5.46 m) at 75 x 65 deg (a fov_mode for 10:9 streams); Y16. min_z is each mode's operating-range minimum. Lens model pinhole is a labelled ASSUMPTION (calibrate a unit). RGB 3840 x 2160 at 5/15/25 fps, 16:9 80 x 51 deg; 1280 x 960 4:3 at 65 x 51 deg; formats YUY2, MJPG, H.264, H.265 (MJPEG entered for the large modes, YUY2 for 1280 x 720: the USB data mode supports "1,920 x 1,080 and below, YUY2 and MJPG"; H.264/H.265 are for Ethernet). Depth error: typical systematic error < 11 mm + 0.1% of distance; random error standard deviation <= 17 mm (15-95% reflectivity at 850 nm, 2.2 uW/cm2/nm, no multi-path). power_w is the USB power + data figure, 10 W (peak 14 W); DC power + USB data 11 W (peak 16 W); PoE + Ethernet 13 W (peak 17 W). size_mm: the stated "Dimensions WxHxD 115 mm x 40 mm x 145 mm", entered as [145, 115, 40]. Mass 560 g. Operating temperature 10-25 C. Mounting bottom 1x 1/4-20 UNC, sides 4x M2.5. Not stated: pixel sizes, f-numbers, RGB focus, distortion.

fov_modes.what: NFOV depth modes (640 x 576 unbinned, 320 x 288 binned)

depth.range_text: 0.25-5.46 m depending on depth mode (15% to 95% reflectivity at 850 nm, 2.2 uW/cm2/nm, no multi-path interference)

rms_error.text: Random error standard deviation (precision) <= 17 mm; typical systematic error (accuracy) < 11 mm + 0.1% of distance (no multi-path interference)

sync.what: Datasheet: "8 Pin-Connector" for multi-device sync; "Precise synchronization trigger control uses standard Ethernet cables"; supported functions "D2C, Multi-Camera Sync".
